## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed. Link a fork issue if available.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Distinguish unit/component tests, browser tests,
real containers and physical devices. State what was not run and why.

## Data, security and compatibility

- [ ] No secrets, private histories, signing keys, catalogues or runtime data are included.
- [ ] Existing histories, snapshots and pending sync operations are preserved, or migration/recovery is explained.
- [ ] Relevant personal and multi-user access boundaries were checked.
- [ ] New media/data have verified provenance and licence terms, with attribution retained.
- [ ] Documentation and known limitations match the implementation.

For a vulnerability, use SECURITY.md instead of opening a public PR with exploit details.
Do not claim Docker or Android validation based only on compilation or simulated tests.
